name: Sync Repair Tooling
description: Tools to detect and repair sync inconsistencies: missing operations, divergent state, broken causal chains.
purpose: Provide diagnostic and repair tooling to detect and fix sync inconsistencies including missing operations, divergent state, and broken causal chains.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect missing operations by comparing vector clocks or operation IDs across devices.
Detect divergent state by comparing snapshot checksums.
Detect broken causal chains (operations applied without all dependencies).
Repair tools can inject missing operations or perform a full snapshot resync.
Repair is interactive (show diff, ask for confirmation) or automated (configurable policy).
Tools produce a human-readable report of detected inconsistencies and repair actions taken.
